page.layout: One text column, with marginal notes in the right margin. Running head and page number at the top.

main_text.l: Prælatorum in subditos, ex lege Dei im-
quiique jus & subjectionis, ex eâdem per-
tis, ne possit obligare: semper enim ob-
cendum ergo in hoc casu primo, non de-
bere subditum in iis rebus in quibus al-
teri subest jurare se facturum quidquam,
consensu. Secundo si juraverit & res sit
non videtur id esse contra voluntatem,
rit, {e} non posse eandem posthac irritam

marginalia.note: Quod semel placuit, amplius displicere non potest. 21. reg. jur. in 6.

page.notes: Doubtful: "relcierit" read as "rescierit" [?]. The long s is shown as "l" in places (for example "fubdito", "pofle") and is normalised to s. Note "e" in the right margin: "Quod semel placuit, amplius displicere non potest. 21. reg. jur. in 6." Right margin also shows a faint fleuron near "fignificaverit" which is not text.
